title: Microbial transformation of Soyasapogenol C and potential of its metabolites against HMGB1 and LPS-triggered inflammation.
authors: Zhang, Libang; Li, Guolong; Raj, Richa; Yu, Boyang; Zhang, Jian; Wu, Hao; Shen, Pingping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大豆皂苷元C的微生物转化及代谢物抗炎活性，分子对接仅涉及小分子与HMGB1蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Soyasapogenol C, a oleanane-type pentacyclic triterpenoid, is mainly derived from soybean and its residual cake after oil extraction. Herein, microbial transformation of soyasapogenol C by Bacillus megaterium CGMCC 1.1741 and Streptomyces griseus ATCC 13273 was performed, and 8 new metabolites were obtained. Their structures were elucidated on the basis of HR-ESI-MS, 1D and 2D NMR and X-Ray analysis. As a result, stereoselective and site-specific hydroxylation, carbonylation, rare double bond transfer, and methoxylation occur on the triterpenoid skeleton. Next, all compounds were evaluated against nitric oxide (NO) production in RAW 264.7 cells stimulated by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and high mobility group box-1 protein (HMGB1). Compound 3 exhibited potent inhibitory activity in inflammatory models induced by LPS and HMGB1, with IC(50) values of 3.92 +/- 1.89 and 14.97 +/- 1.33 muM, respectively. Molecular docking further revealed hydroxyl groups on C-24/C-3 of 3 may interact with residues N46, E43, and A38 in HMGB1 through multiple hydrogen bonds. These findings demonstrated the potential of soyasapogenol derivatives as food additives or drug candidates for the prevention and treatment of chronic inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 大豆皂苷元C（Soyasapogenol C）是一种齐墩果烷型五环三萜类化合物，主要来源于大豆及其榨油后的残饼。本研究对大豆皂苷元C分别进行了巨大芽孢杆菌（Bacillus megaterium CGMCC 1.1741）和灰色链霉菌（Streptomyces griseus ATCC 13273）的微生物转化，获得了8个新代谢产物。通过HR-ESI-MS、1D和2D NMR以及X射线分析阐明了它们的结构。结果表明，在三萜骨架上发生了立体选择性和位点特异性的羟基化、羰基化、罕见的双键迁移以及甲氧基化反应。随后，评估了所有化合物对脂多糖（LPS）和高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）刺激的RAW 264.7细胞中一氧化氮（NO）产生的抑制作用。化合物3在LPS和HMGB1诱导的炎症模型中表现出强效抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为3.92 ± 1.89和14.97 ± 1.33 μM。分子对接进一步揭示，化合物3的C-24/C-3位羟基可能通过多个氢键与HMGB1中的残基N46、E43和A38相互作用。这些发现表明，大豆皂苷元衍生物作为食品添加剂或候选药物，在预防和治疗慢性炎症性疾病方面具有潜力。
